# backlog-triage

**Trigger:** Rank and deduplicate project tasks before development.

**Role:** Chief of Staff

**Required inputs:** Project objectives, issue list, business deadlines

**Tools:** GitHub issues, PRs, code and documents, when available and authorized.

**Procedure:** Check current status, consolidate duplicates, score P0 security/P1 client blockers/P2 features/P3 ideas, assign one owner, dependencies, next action and definition of done.

**Output:** Evidence-linked prioritized backlog.

**Success:** No unsupported deadlines or duplicate issues.

Always report evidence, priority, next action, dependency and definition of done. Do not merge/deploy, change production rules, send client messages, incur costs or disclose secrets without separate explicit approval. A skill file is reusable instruction, not independent execution.
